note: Authored, fictional or paraphrased game content. Reference texts are the authored ground truth for grading; urls are placeholders on example.test. Never put a real friend question here.

cases.question: Where is the Sunken Vault entrance and what levels is it for?

reference.text: The Sunken Vault entrance is in Mossback Ridge. The dungeon is tuned for levels 28 to 34 and takes five players.

cases.question: How long is the Ember Rite attunement chain?

reference.text: The Ember Rite attunement has 9 quests, starts at Cinder Post and takes about 3 hours.

cases.question: How much does the first mount cost?

reference.text: The basic mount costs 60 gold at level 40 from the Stablemaster in Dawnhold. Riding skill is trained separately.

cases.question: When do dungeon lockouts reset?

reference.text: Dungeon lockouts reset daily at 04:00 server time as of the 2026-11-10 hotfix.

cases.question: How many talent points do I have at level 40 and what does dual spec cost?

reference.text: At level 40 a character has spent 31 talent points. Dual spec unlocks at level 40 and costs 10 gold.

cases.question: Which professions can make the bigger bags?

reference.text: Tailoring makes bags of up to 16 slots from Mooncloth. Leatherworking makes ammo pouches, not general bags.

cases.question: What does the Frostward spell do for a frost caster?

reference.text: Frostward absorbs the next 120 damage from a single school for 30 seconds and has a 45 second cooldown.

cases.question: Where do I train advanced cooking and what does it cost?

reference.text: Advanced cooking is trained by Marta Quillon in Saltmere at skill 150 and costs 4 gold.

cases.question: How many players does Tidewatch Keep take and what levels is it for?

reference.text: Tidewatch Keep is a ten-player dungeon in Saltmere tuned for levels 41 to 46 with a weekly lockout.

cases.question: What does the key quest for the Ashen Reliquary ask for?

reference.text: The Ashen Reliquary key quest needs 12 Ember Shards and 3 Cinder Wicks, handed in at Cinder Post.

cases.question: How long is the flight from Dawnhold to Saltmere and what does it cost?

reference.text: The flight from Dawnhold to Saltmere takes 6 minutes and costs 2 gold 50 silver.

cases.question: At what level can I train riding and where?

reference.text: Riding skill unlocks at level 40 and is trained at the Dawnhold stables for 35 gold.

cases.question: How many tabs does the guild bank have and what does the first one cost?

reference.text: The guild bank has 6 tabs of 98 slots each. The first tab costs 100 gold.

cases.question: How long is the Hearthstone cooldown?

reference.text: The Hearthstone has a 30 minute cooldown and binds at an inn.

cases.question: What is the level cap on the current realm?

reference.text: The level cap is 50 on the current realm as of the 2026-11-10 hotfix.

cases.question: How fast does rested experience build in an inn?

reference.text: Rested experience builds at 5 percent of a level per 8 hours spent in an inn.

cases.question: How long is the Thornfall quest chain and what does it reward?

reference.text: The Thornfall chain has 14 quests, ends at the Harrowgate Watch and rewards a ring.

cases.question: What cut does the auction house take and what is the deposit?

reference.text: The auction house cut is 5 percent. The deposit for a 12 hour listing is 3 percent.

cases.question: How many dungeon instances can I enter per hour?

reference.text: A character can enter 5 dungeon instances per hour.

cases.question: When does the weekly reset happen?

reference.text: The weekly reset is Tuesday at 09:00 server time as of the 2026-11-10 hotfix.

cases.question: Where does Marshbloom grow and what herbalism skill does it need?

reference.text: Marshbloom grows in Brindlefen and needs herbalism skill 125.
